user.title: Connect to CTEK Nanogrid Air
user.description: Enter the device hostname or IP address without http:// or a port. Most devices allow API reads without login; leave username and password empty unless your device requires them.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Nanogrid credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Keep the existing device address and port. Enter both username and password only if your device requires API login.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect or read device information.
error.invalid_auth: The device requires API login or rejected the supplied credentials.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid hostname or IP address and a port between 1 and 65535.
error.address_changed: Keep the existing host and port when updating credentials.
